profile.name: Momchil Todorov
profile.intro: I build custom WordPress and WooCommerce functionality — connecting thoughtful interfaces with the business logic underneath.
profile.bio: I’m a senior full-stack WordPress developer with 5+ years of agency experience building and supporting websites for international clients.
profile.agencyBio: Since February 2021, I’ve worked at tzn digital ventures GmbH, developing WordPress and WooCommerce projects from requirements and design handoff through implementation and production support.
profile.focusBio: My work combines custom PHP and MySQL development with responsive interfaces, third-party integrations and practical production troubleshooting.

projects.title: LIGRE Coffee Equipment
projects.summary: Connecting partner orders with affiliate commissions and B2B workflows.
projects.contentHTML:
Project context

This work connected partner ordering, affiliate commissions and B2B operations within a WooCommerce implementation.

My contribution

  • Built workflows for partner orders.
  • Integrated Affiliate for WooCommerce with multi-level commission functionality.
  • Developed REST endpoints to support the connected B2B operations.

Delivered functionality

Delivered connected partner-order and affiliate workflows within the project’s WooCommerce setup.

projects.title: Walhalla Weine
projects.summary: Keeping a WooCommerce catalog connected to the VinX ERP system.
projects.contentHTML:
Project context

The integration brought product, inventory, pricing, image and attribute data from VinX ERP into WooCommerce.

My contribution

  • Integrated WooCommerce with the VinX ERP system.
  • Built scheduled imports and synchronization logic using REST APIs.
  • Automated updates for products, stock, pricing, images and attributes.

Delivered functionality

Delivered automated catalog updates between the ERP system and the WooCommerce store.

projects.title: Elfbar.de
projects.summary: Product configuration and tailored business logic for an online store.
projects.contentHTML:

My contribution focused on tailored WooCommerce functionality and the technical behavior behind the store.

projects.title: tzn Digital
projects.summary: Turning supplied designs into a responsive, interactive agency website.
projects.contentHTML:
Project context

The project combined responsive development with interactive elements, third-party services and consent-aware analytics.

My contribution

  • Built the corporate WordPress site and responsive homepage from supplied designs.
  • Delivered AJAX filters, GSAP animations, third-party widgets and video integrations.
  • Implemented consent-aware GA4 and marketing scripts.
  • Contributed to Core Web Vitals improvements.

Delivered functionality

Delivered responsive pages and interactive functionality, with analytics scripts integrated around user consent.
